question: Beyond the initial establishment, what ongoing operational and administrative mechanisms will the Alabama Council on Advanced Technology and Artificial Intelligence utilize to effectively review and advise on the use and development of advanced technology and AI in the state?
answer_low_temp:
The Alabama Council on Advanced Technology and Artificial Intelligence will utilize the following ongoing operational and administrative mechanisms to effectively review and advise on the use and development of advanced technology and AI in the state:

1. Meetings: The council shall meet at least twice a year, but may meet more frequently upon the call of the chair. Members of the council may participate in a meeting of the council by means of conference telephone, video conference, or similar communications equipment by means which allow all persons participating in the meeting to hear each other and otherwise participate in the meeting.
